'''Hurdenn's Rodian mistress''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] she was living on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where she became a mistress of the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hurdenn]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]], working under Hurdenn's command, learned about the affair and blackmailed Hurden into transferring him to serve under the [[Emperor's Wrath]], far away from Taris.<ref name="Promotion">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Pierce|Promotion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hurdenn's Rodian mistress is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Sith Warrior-class-exclusive companion conversation of Lieutenant Pierce.<ref name="Promotion" />
